power-white: White power. Choose one free upgrade. The numbers on each card show what it changes.
power-green: Green power. Choose one free upgrade. The numbers on each card show what it changes.
power-blue: Blue power. Choose one free upgrade. The numbers on each card show what it changes.
power-purple: Purple power. Choose one free upgrade. The numbers on each card show what it changes.
cache: Choose one supply bundle. Accept keeps the bundle. Sell trades the whole bundle for salvage. The other choices close.
buy: Buy spends the salvage price shown on the card. Read the changes before buying. Shopping is optional.
equip: Equip puts an ammo type into an active slot. Its effect joins the blaster's shots. If all slots are full, it replaces the rightmost ammo. The old ammo stays in your reserve.
merge: Merge combines two cartridges of the same type and tier into one stronger cartridge. Preview the selected pairs, then confirm. Only the selected ingredients are used.
forge: Legendary Omni Ammo combines one purple cartridge of each of the five ammo types. Check the selected ingredients and resulting equipment, then press Forge. You can forge once per run.
next-wave: Next wave starts combat with your current equipment. No purchase is required.
save-exit: Save and exit keeps your mission so you can resume later. Wait for the save to finish.
piercing: Piercing lets a shot pass through enemies.
electric-chain: Electric Chain jumps between nearby enemies.
armor: Armor reduces damage when enemies hit you.
reroll: Reroll spends salvage to replace unpurchased shop choices. The price is shown on the button.
sell: Sell removes the selected cartridge and gives you the salvage shown. Check the quantity before selling.
